points.name: settings.screenshot.toggle_register
points.interpretation: The row builder registers callback 0xc56f0b5 with filter 7 and forwards its second argument as event user data.

points.name: settings.screenshot.event_code
points.interpretation: The callback proceeds only for event code 7.

points.name: settings.screenshot.event_data
points.interpretation: The callback proceeds only when the low byte of event user data is zero.

points.name: settings.screenshot.description
points.interpretation: The row builder assigns the screenshot_info.settings translation to a label.

evidence: The settings manifest includes the page descriptor. The create routine stores a list view and associates it with a row table containing the row builder; the row builder sets the description and registers the event callback. Destroy clears the list-view slot. The event callback checks event code and user data before interacting with the view.
scope: Only the specific recorded shared calls while the page state is active; this does not intercept every screenshot path.
limitations: Skipping or changing callbacks, event data, or lifecycle actions may leave settings UI state inconsistent. State and root slots do not provide thread quiescence. Static analysis only; device behavior and recovery are unverified.
